title: UGAS schema bundle
description: Self-contained bundle of every UGAS entity schema. Validate an entity against #/$defs/<type> (type = the <type> in its $schema), or against the whole bundle to dispatch on $schema automatically. Resolves offline.

attribute.title: Attribute Definition Schema
attribute.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Appendix B

attribute_set.title: AttributeSet Definition Schema
attribute_set.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Appendix B

gameplay_ability.title: Ability Definition Schema
gameplay_ability.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Appendix B

BlockedByTags.description: Tags that prevent this ability from running

BlockAbilitiesWithTags.description: While this ability is active, block abilities with these tags

CancelAbilitiesWithTags.description: Cancel abilities with these tags when this ability activates

ActivationRequiredTags.description: Tags required on the GC to activate this ability

ActivationBlockedTags.description: Tags that block activation of this ability

ActivationOwnedTags.description: Tags granted to the GC while this ability is active

MaxRange.description: Maximum targeting range in engine units (§17.3). Absent or 0 means self-targeted / no range gate; a target-requiring activation MUST be within range (§17.2 Distance), validated server-side per §13.7.

AsyncValidation.description: Optional asynchronous server-side validation for activation (§8.8). When present and Required is true, an activation that passes the synchronous checks enters PendingConfirmation before Commit instead of committing synchronously.

Required.description: If true, route activation through the PendingConfirmation state and await server validation before Commit. Absent or false keeps the synchronous Validating -> Commit behaviour.

Kind.description: Category of asynchronous validation, e.g. AntiCheat | RemoteInventory | Entitlement | Custom.

TimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the validation result before treating it as an asynchronous failure (transition Fail -> Granted, nothing consumed).

Predicted.description: If true, the owning client MAY speculatively commit and enter Active while the server holds PendingConfirmation, reconciling via the prediction model (§13.8).

TickInterval.description: Seconds between task ticks; 0 means every frame. Only meaningful for ticking tasks.

Priority.description: Tick scheduling priority when the per-frame tick budget is exhausted; higher ticks first.

gameplay_controller.title: Gameplay Controller Interface Schema Definition
gameplay_controller.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 4

OwnerActor.description: Logical owner of the GC (responsible for lifecycle, network authority, persistence)

ActorID.description: Unique identifier for the owner actor

AvatarActor.description: World spatial representation (optional, can be same as Owner)

ActorID.description: Unique identifier for the avatar actor

InputID.description: Input binding identifier. References an Action Name from the input layer. When the bound Action triggers, the GC calls TryActivateAbility for this grant.

Handle.description: Unique handle for this granted ability instance

bIsActive.description: Whether the ability is currently active

GrantedAbilities.description: All abilities granted to this GC

Handle.description: Unique identifier for this active effect

DurationPolicy.description: Duration policy of the originating effect (§14.3)

RemainingDuration.description: Remaining duration in seconds. Present only for HasDuration effects (§14.3.1)

InstigatorGC.description: Reference to the GC that caused this effect

SourceAbility.description: Ability that applied this effect (for provenance tracking, §14.3.2)

PeriodicState.description: Periodic execution state for effects with Period settings (§14.3.3)

PeriodElapsed.description: Seconds elapsed since last periodic execution

CapturedAttributes.description: Attribute values captured OnApplication, keyed by attribute name (§14.3)

SetByCallerMagnitudes.description: Runtime-provided magnitudes, keyed by data tag (§14.3)

ActiveEffects.description: Currently active effects applied to this GC (serialization protocol §14)

ActiveActionSets.description: Currently active ActionSet names (derived from tag evaluation at runtime)

OwnedTags.description: Current semantic state tags (hierarchical dot notation)

ReplicationMode.description: Replication strategy: Minimal (only cues & tags for AI), Mixed (full to owner, minimal to others for players), Full (complete to all for single-player/spectators), None (no replication for server-only)

bIsActive.description: Whether this GC is currently active

Metadata.description: Optional metadata for display and debugging

gameplay_effect.title: GameplayEffect Definition Schema
gameplay_effect.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Appendix B

ExecuteOnApplication.description: Whether to execute immediately on application

Priority.description: Override conflict resolution priority. When multiple active effects apply an Override modifier to the same Attribute, the effect with the highest Priority value wins. On equal Priority, last-applied wins (LIFO). Negative values are valid.

GrantedTags.description: Tags granted while this effect is active

ApplicationRequiredTags.description: Tags required on target for effect to apply

Area.description: Optional area application (§17.3). When present, the effect applies to every anchor matching the filter within the shape (via the §17.2 spatial queries) instead of a single target; the execution policy (§9.6) governs per-target combination.

Shape.description: Query shape centered at the application origin (EffectContext.WorldOrigin, §9.9).

Radius.description: Sphere radius / cone range. May be AttributeBased to scale with an attribute (§9.4.2).

HalfAngleDeg.description: Cone half-angle in degrees (Cone shape only).

RequireTags.description: Candidate must own all these tags (§7, hierarchical). Empty = no requirement.

ExcludeTags.description: Candidate must own none of these tags.

Affiliation.description: Affiliation of candidates relative to the applying GC (§17.2).

MaxTargets.description: Cap on affected targets (0 = unbounded), applied after ordering.

BackingAttribute.description: Attribute to use for AttributeBased magnitude

Source.description: Which GC to read the backing attribute from

CalculatorClass.description: Custom calculation class for CustomCalculation type

Operation.description: Mathematical operation to apply. Add: pre-multiply flat additive (pipeline step 2, before the multiply steps). Multiply: signed bonus aggregated per Channel at step 4 — the channel factor is (1 + sum of magnitudes), so +0.25 means +25% and -0.25 means -25%. There is no Divide operation: express a 50% reduction as Multiply with magnitude -0.5. AddPost: post-multiply flat additive (pipeline step 5, after all multiply steps; very rare). Override: replaces the computed result at step 6. Step numbers refer to the Current-Value pipeline (§5.3). On an Instant effect each modifier instead writes the Base Value directly in authored order, where Multiply scales the base by (1 + magnitude) with no channel grouping — so magnitude 0 is the identity (§5.2).

Channel.description: Optional named aggregation channel for Multiply modifiers. Modifiers sharing a channel sum their magnitudes into a single factor of (1 + sum); distinct channels produce factors that multiply against each other. Used for damage-bucket systems (see §5.3 Channel Aggregation). Omit to place the modifier in its own implicit singleton channel, contributing (1 + magnitude) independently of every other modifier — omission does NOT pool modifiers into a shared global channel. Ignored on Add, AddPost, and Override modifiers.

gameplay_tag.title: Tag Registry Schema
gameplay_tag.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Appendix B

Tag.description: Hierarchical tag in dot notation (e.g., State.Debuff.Stunned)

input_action.title: Input Action Definition Schema
input_action.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 11

Name.description: Unique identifier for this action, referenced by InputID on granted abilities

ValueType.description: Semantic value type this action produces. Digital actions emit trigger events (Started/Ongoing/Completed). Axis actions emit a continuous value each frame while nonzero.

TriggerBehavior.description: When this action fires its trigger event. OnPressed fires once on activation. WhileHeld fires every frame while input is nonzero. OnTap requires press-then-release within TapThreshold.

TapThreshold.description: Maximum hold duration (seconds) for OnTap and OnDoubleTap

DoubleTapWindow.description: Maximum gap (seconds) between two taps for OnDoubleTap

ConsumeInput.description: Whether this action consumes the input event, preventing lower-priority actions from receiving it

ActionTags.description: Tags describing this action for bulk queries (e.g. disable all combat inputs)

DisplayName.description: Localization-friendly name shown in control remapping UI

Category.description: UI grouping for settings screens (e.g. Movement, Combat)

input_action_set.title: Input Action Set Definition Schema
input_action_set.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 11

Name.description: Unique identifier for this action set

Actions.description: Actions available when this set is active

Priority.description: When multiple sets are active and contain the same Action, the highest priority wins. Enables layering (e.g. a Dialogue set overlays OnFoot).

RequiredTags.description: Tags required on the owning GC for this set to be active (AND logic)

BlockedTags.description: Tags that deactivate this set if any are present on the GC

Exclusive.description: If true, activating this set deactivates all other non-exclusive sets at the same or lower priority. Useful for modal contexts like vehicles or cutscenes.

InputBuffer.description: Per-set input buffering configuration, overrides the global InputBufferConfig

input_mapping.title: Input Mapping Definition Schema
input_mapping.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 11

ActionSet.description: The ActionSet this mapping belongs to

Platform.description: Optional platform filter. When set, these bindings only apply on the specified platform. Omit for universal bindings.

Input.description: Canonical input identifier within the device family, using a standardized naming convention independent of any engine (e.g. Key.Space, Mouse.LeftButton, Gamepad.FaceBottom)

CustomDeviceName.description: When Device is Custom, the specific hardware identifier (e.g. FlightStick, SteeringWheel)

CompositeInputs.description: Composes multiple digital inputs into an axis value. Used for WASD-to-2D-vector, arrow-keys-to-axis, etc.

Inputs.description: Device input(s) for this binding. A single entry is a simple binding. Multiple entries create a chord (all must be active simultaneously).

Modifiers.description: Ordered list of Modifier references applied to the raw input value (pipeline order)

Priority.description: When multiple bindings map to the same Action within the same ActionSet, the highest priority binding that is satisfiable wins.

HoldThreshold.description: Seconds the input must be held before the binding activates. Useful for distinguishing tap (interact) from hold (pick up).

bIsRebindable.description: Whether the player can change this binding in controls settings

RequiredTags.description: Additional tag requirements beyond the ActionSet's ActivationTags

input_modifier.title: Input Modifier Definition Schema
input_modifier.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 11

Type.description: The processing operation this modifier performs

InnerThreshold.description: DeadZone: values below this threshold are clamped to zero

OuterThreshold.description: DeadZone: values above this threshold are clamped to 1.0

DeadZoneShape.description: DeadZone: Axial applies per-axis, Radial applies to magnitude of 2D vector

MultiplierX.description: Sensitivity: per-axis X multiplier for 2D actions

MultiplierY.description: Sensitivity: per-axis Y multiplier for 2D actions

Exponent.description: ResponseCurve: exponent for Exponential curves (1.0 = linear, 2.0 = quadratic)

CurvePoints.description: ResponseCurve: explicit input-to-output mapping points for Custom curves

SwizzleOrder.description: AxisSwizzle: axis reordering (e.g. YXZ to swap X and Y)

PressThreshold.description: TriggerThreshold: analog value above which a trigger counts as pressed

CalculatorClass.description: Custom: engine-specific class implementing the modifier logic

UserConfigurable.description: Whether this modifier's params are exposed in the player's settings screen. When true, the runtime SHOULD present relevant params (e.g. sensitivity slider, invert-Y toggle) in the controls menu.

DisplayName.description: Name shown in settings UI when UserConfigurable

scene.title: Scene Composition Schema
scene.description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 18

Extends.description: Names of parent scenes this scene composes on top of, additively

Placements.description: Gameplay Controller instances placed into the world

Controller.description: Name of the GameplayControllerConfig to instantiate

InstanceId.description: Stable identity for this instance, used as the persistence key

Position.description: World position as x, y, z

Rotation.description: World rotation as a quaternion x, y, z, w

StartupTags.description: Tags granted to the instance on spawn

StartupEffects.description: Effects applied to the instance on spawn

AttributeOverrides.description: Base value overrides applied after the controller defaults

Enabled.description: Whether the instance spawns active (default true)

Regions.description: Standing zones active while the scene is loaded

Position.description: Region origin as x, y, z

GrantedTags.description: Tags granted to occupants while inside the region

SpawnPoints.description: Named poses for dynamic spawning at runtime

Position.description: Spawn position as x, y, z

Rotation.description: Spawn rotation as a quaternion x, y, z, w
